description: This PHP source file is a set of unit tests for the ClaimDaoAttachment component within the OrangeHRM Claim Plugin. It tests various CRUD operations and retrieval functions related to claim attachments, including fetching partial attachments, counting, listing, saving, deleting, and retrieving attachment files.

classes.name: ClaimDaoAttachmentTest
classes.description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing ClaimDao's attachment-related data access methods in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a partial claim attachment by ID and request ID, verifying the attachment ID and filename.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of claim attachments based on a search filter parameter.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of claim attachments and verifying the number and filename of the first item.

methods.name: testGetNextAttachmentId
methods.description: Tests retrieving the next available attachment ID for a specific request ID.

methods.name: testSaveClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests creating, saving, and retrieving a claim attachment with a large data URI, then verifies saved data.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of claim attachments by ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializing ClaimDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Tests fetching a claim attachment file and verifying its description, filename, and attachment content.
